correctness.rationale: The verifier constructs the Fano incidence graph from xor-zero triples and uses two separately implemented zero-forcing closures on every six-subset. It proves by exhaustive checks that all 3473 subsets of size at most five fail, precisely 700 of 3003 six-subsets succeed, and these are exactly the 700 of 784 noncollinear/nonconcurrent triple pairs with \(\ge3\) incidences; the remaining 84 fail. All 336 actual incidence automorphisms are constructed from \(\mathrm{GL}(3,2)\) and polarity, verifying five symmetry orbits, shape/time census; 700 complete BFS runs verify exchange connectivity, 5712 edges, and exact diameter-six distance multiplicities. Finite bounds and rule equivalence are described in RESULT.md; the packaged verifier passed. No infinite claim is made.

The Heawood matching-complex result is a topological invariant of edge matchings, with no reduction shown to the forcing-base exchange graph.

originality.rationale: The result claimed as new is the Fano three-incidence characterization of ALL 700 ordinary six-seed forcing bases, their five graph-automorphism orbits and parallel propagation strata, and the connected diameter-six one-vertex-exchange graph. The zero-forcing number six is already known and is explicitly not a novelty claim.
